title: "West Denmark · DK1"

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/project.R")
source("R/plots.R")
source("scripts/site-helpers.R")
snapshot <- site_read_snapshot()
zone <- "DK1"
summary <- snapshot$summaries[[zone]]
```

::: {.publication-hero .zone-hero}
::: {.eyebrow}
West Denmark · DK1
:::

## Find a lower wholesale-price window

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat('<p class="lead">', site_escape(site_window_hero(snapshot, zone)), '</p>', sep = "")
```

These are wholesale prices before VAT, grid charges, tax and supplier add-ons.
Your consumer cost depends on your local grid operator and electricity agreement.
:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_metadata(snapshot, zone)
```

## Today's quarter-hour prices

```{r}
#| label: daily-prices
#| fig-alt: "DK1 quarter-hour wholesale prices, with the historical median and Q25 to Q75 band for the previous 30 completed days."
plot_daily_prices(snapshot, zone)
```

The snapshot's reference profile uses the previous **30 completed Copenhagen
days**, excluding today. The dashed line is the median and the band is Q25–Q75
at each local clock time. Read the coverage details for incomplete history.

## Cheapest published window

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_windows(summary$upcoming_window, "DK1 · cheapest complete upcoming wholesale window")
```

The start is inclusive and the end exclusive. Cost assumes a constant 1 kW load
throughout the window, before all consumer charges.

## Today's hourly prices

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_today(snapshot, zone)
```

Hourly values come from the shared analysis of quarter-hour prices. CET/CEST
labels distinguish repeated clock hours when daylight saving time ends.

## Recent and published prices

```{r}
#| label: hourly-overview
#| fig-alt: "DK1 hourly wholesale spot prices over the last seven days and all published future hours, including negative prices."
plot_hourly_overview(snapshot, zone)
```

## Period averages

```{r}
#| results: asis
periods <- summary$period_averages
names(periods) <- c("Period", "Wholesale average (DKK/kWh)")
site_table(periods, "DK1 · wholesale period averages")
```

## Cheapest historical window

This is the cheapest complete eligible wholesale window retained by the shared
analysis over its **six-month history**. It describes the past, not a future offer.

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_windows(summary$historical_window, "DK1 · six-month historical cheapest wholesale window")
```

## Quarter-hour values

```{r}
#| results: asis
quarters <- summary$quarter_today[, c("TimeUTC", "SpotPriceDKK"), drop = FALSE]
names(quarters) <- c("Interval start (Copenhagen)", "Wholesale spot (DKK/kWh)")
site_table(quarters, "DK1 · today's published quarter-hour values")
```
